entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. Just connect me to a person already! I've been on hold for ages!
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Finally! I want to return this helmet I bought. This whole process is a joke, and if you don't process my return right now, I'm lighting you up on every review site on the internet.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

It's the wrong color! It looked completely different on your website. I don't care about its so-called 'safety' features if it's this ugly. The box is unopened, it's brand new. Just give me my money back. I want to speak to your manager if this is going to be a problem.
I understand your frustration with the color, and there's no need for a manager just yet. I can definitely handle this for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yeah, hold on. It's VF-8675309. You'd better not tell me I'm past some ridiculous return window.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered on November 23rd of last year. That was 47 days ago.
So what? It's been sitting in the closet. Like I said, the box is unopened. Are you trying to get out of this?
Not at all. I was just confirming the details. For a standard item like this helmet, VeloFit has a 90-day return policy. You are well within that timeframe.
Oh. So... you'll take it back?

Yes, absolutely. Since it's within the 90-day period, I can process this return for you right now. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email on file. Just print it, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Well... okay then. That's... fine. I guess that works. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
